title: Atrinik
description: Atrinik is a free, open-source online role-playing world, shaped since 2009 by its creators and community and developed in the open.

homepage.title: Free, open-source online role-playing game
homepage.description: Atrinik is a free, open-source online role-playing game. Download Atrinik Classic for Windows or Linux; the next-generation game is in development.
homepage.heading: Atrinik is a cooperative fantasy game.
homepage.introduction: Explore Atrinik’s isometric islands, ruins, and crystal-lit mysteries with other players. The maintained Classic release is available for Windows and Linux; the next-generation game remains in development.

privacy.providerEdgeDisclosure: Cloudflare may inject bot/security JavaScript or a dashboard-managed Web Analytics beacon, set strictly necessary cookies, or serve a challenge with its own HTML, scripts, cookies, and CSP. The ordinary page's no-script CSP blocks injected scripts.

identity.heading: A world shaped by its creators and its community.
identity.creators: Atrinik's creators shape its maps, quests, dialogue, lore, art, music, and sound, and review what goes into the game. Every asset keeps its exact credit, source, and license.
identity.community: Atrinik is developed in the open. Anyone can follow the work, report problems, suggest ideas, and contribute changes, which pass the same review, provenance, licensing, and validation checks.
identity.websiteArtwork: The concept artwork on this website is by Zoey Rose. It is presentation material, not game content or gameplay footage, and is credited in the site's media inventory.
